0.why: EvoSeq writes one value into this port and never calls setChannels

1.why: EvoSeq writes one value into this port and never calls setChannels

2.why: EvoSeq writes 0V or 10V into one channel of this port and never calls setChannels

comment: No source is published; read from the maker's manual. BtnAndTrig::process is the common button-and-trigger reader: the trigger arms above 2.0V and re-arms below 0.1V, and the button and the trigger are combined so either one acts. Gate Length and Swing are menu-only parameters with no census position; the Lock button of each block has none either.
